# Polls triggers

## Chat poll ended

Runs when a chat poll ends. Good for announcing which choice won.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The poll's question |
| `%winningChoice%` | The text of the winning choice (empty if nobody voted) |
| `%winningVotes%` | How many votes the winner got |
| `%totalVotes%` | How many votes there were in all |
| `%choice0Title%` | The first choice's text (choice1Title is the second, and so on) |
| `%choice0Votes%` | How many votes the first choice got (choice1Votes is the second, and so on) |
| `%canceled%` | True if the poll was cancelled |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.pollEnded`</small>

## Chat poll started

Runs when a chat poll starts. Good for announcing the question and how to vote in chat.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The poll's question |
| `%choiceCount%` | How many choices there are |
| `%choice0Title%` | The first choice's text (choice1Title is the second, and so on) |
| `%duration%` | How many seconds the poll lasts (0 = until you end it) |
| `%pollId%` | The poll's internal id |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.pollStarted`</small>

## Chat prediction cancelled

Runs when a prediction is cancelled and every bet is given back. Good for telling chat that the points are back.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The prediction's question |
| `%totalUsers%` | How many viewers had bet |
| `%totalPoints%` | How many points are given back in all |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.predictionCanceled`</small>

## Chat prediction locked

Runs when a chat prediction is locked, so no more bets are taken. Good for saying "bets are closed".

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The prediction's question |
| `%totalUsers%` | How many viewers bet |
| `%totalPoints%` | How many points were bet in all |
| `%outcome0Points%` | Points bet on the first outcome (outcome1Points is the second, and so on) |
| `%currency%` | The name of the points that were bet |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.predictionLocked`</small>

## Chat prediction resolved

Runs when you pick the winning outcome of a prediction and the winners get paid. Good for announcing the result.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The prediction's question |
| `%winningOutcome%` | The text of the winning outcome |
| `%winnerCount%` | How many viewers won points |
| `%paidOut%` | How many points were paid out in all |
| `%totalPoints%` | How many points were bet in all |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.predictionResolved`</small>

## Chat prediction started

Runs when a chat prediction opens for bets. Viewers bet their points on what will happen. Good for announcing the question.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The prediction's question |
| `%outcomeCount%` | How many outcomes there are |
| `%outcome0Title%` | The first outcome's text (outcome1Title is the second, and so on) |
| `%window%` | How many seconds bets are taken (0 = until you lock it) |
| `%currency%` | The name of the points that are bet |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.predictionStarted`</small>
